generic_domain.justification: Pre-training is the broader concept that encompasses contrastive pretraining, among many other types of pretraining methods. Pre-Training generally refers to the process of training a model on a large dataset in order to build a general understanding of some aspect of data before it is fine-tuned for a specific task. Contrastive pretraining is a specific type of pre-training method where models are trained in a way that they can differentiate between similar and dissimilar data points, which helps them learning useful representations.
